description: Is it a 7 day trial or paid subscription access? Stop giving away your value 🤍 #selfmastery #quantumleap #PersonalGrowth
transcript: We do not have to give everything and everyone premium access to us. Sometimes the world deserves a seven-day trial. I've learned to be flexible and be comfortable wearing different masks in different hats because the world does not always deserve full premium access and a full premium subscription. And that's okay. Sometimes we invest too much in environments in which don't deserve our value or do not align with who we are. And that's okay. There are ample opportunities out there to give premium access to the things that deserve it, the things that will add value to you. Sometimes we do too much and less is more.
